conceptual_statement: Washington’s strongest Trust Hub evidence is its statewide contractor registration, bond, and liability-insurance graph on exact L&I contractor IDs, plus a DSHS residential-care inventory that includes Adult Family Homes as a state-only class. Moving, lending, investor, and insurance research add Washington regulatory context to existing federal and national spines. Several live state rosters remain search-only or commercially restricted. Organizations and evidence records stay separate. Missing, restricted, and search-only sources are unknown — not zero.

what_makes_washington_different: L&I publishes contractor registration, bond, and liability-insurance filings on exact contractor IDs. Registration is not quality. A missing bond row is not proof the contractor is unbonded.
Washington has more than six thousand Adult Family Homes — a state-specific residential-care class outside CMS nursing-home identity. AFH is not ALF. ALF is not a skilled nursing facility.
Household-goods mover authority is a UTC state permit and remains distinct from FMCSA interstate authority. A USDOT number is not interstate operating authority by itself.
HMDA shows complete statewide 2025 mortgage-market activity while DFI’s live company roster remains search-only. HMDA is not a license roster. Denial rate is not quality.
SEC/IARD Washington principal-office geography is not state adviser registration. 306 is not the 645 DFI year-end IA aggregate, and 645 is not a live roster.
OIC person-list restrictions (RCW 42.56) affect what can ethically and legally be bulk acquired. Producer lists stay restricted. 2,924 is not a live Washington insurer count.

NET_NEW_CANONICAL_ORGANIZATIONS.explanation: Move specialist ledger is 0 net-new mover organizations. Insurance specialist ledger is 0. Lender HMDA 286,871 is applications, not companies. Senior published AFH+ALF+ESF = 6,752 state-only facility identities, but WA-SEN-001 did not commit a before/after canonical-organization ledger. Ask does not mint organizations and does not guess.
